_comment: The action vocabulary, as DATA. This used to be three hardcoded dicts in two modules: ARCHETYPE_HOURS in gametime.py, stat_by_action in turn._contest, and the opposing-stat inversion in turn._actor_stat_for. Those three dicts WERE the scenario lock-in — everything else in the engine is already scenario-agnostic. Moving them here is what makes 'resolve a battle' a different actions.json rather than a different codebase.
_comment_fields: id: what the referee returns. hours: default elapsed time when the model omits or mangles hours_elapsed. actor_stat: what the ACTOR rolls. opposing_stat: what RESISTS. tags: free-form, read by optional subsystems — 'discovery' enables evidence searching, 'engagement' routes to combat.resolve_engagement. Unknown tags are ignored, so adding one never breaks an existing scenario.
